question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

If Peter said he would get that book for you, he will do it. He always ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"keeps his word"** means to do what one has promised. (अपने वादे को निभाना)

 
 
• **Example:** John always **keeps his word**, so if he promised to help, he will be there.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **keeps his word**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Keeps under his hat** (राज़ रखना): To keep something secret.

 
 
• **Example:** He kept the surprise party under his hat until the last moment.
 
 
 
• **Keeps him at arm’s length** (दूरी बनाए रखना): To avoid becoming too friendly or involved with someone.
 
 
• **Example:** She keeps her colleagues at arm's length to maintain professionalism.
 
 
 
• **Keeps his shirt on** (शांत रहना): To stay calm or patient.
 
 
• **Example:** Even in stressful situations, he always keeps his shirt on.
